# UX and Content Checklist: Author card at the end of posts

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of copy, link, placement, responsive layout and image performance requirements for the author card
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests the quality of the requirements, not the implementation.

## Placement and Layout

- [x] CHK020 Is the end-of-post order fully specified for every post variant (with and without the questions panel, with and without Related posts)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK021 Is "lines up with the views note and Share area" defined by measurable edges at each breakpoint? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK022 Is the photo's size, shape and placement (above or beside the text) specified at each width, rather than "may sit above or beside"? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Is the visual treatment ("the site's existing card style") tied to a named existing component or token set? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for very long or wrapped role lines and link texts, including at 320 px? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK025 Is the relationship between the new card and the visually similar title card and Related posts cards defined so the author card is distinguishable from them? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Copy

- [x] CHK026 Is the two-line constraint defined (two sentences, two rendered lines, or two paragraphs), given that wrapping changes the line count? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK027 Are the draft lines and the link texts consistent in voice (first person, plain language) with the site's writing rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK028 Is the process for Don's wording revision defined (what counts as the final text, and whether tests tie to the exact wording or to rules)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK029 Is the role text's agreement with the About page defined as a checkable relationship rather than two copies that can drift? [Consistency, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK030 Is the stale-wording prohibition scoped (which phrases besides "Cloud Architect" are banned)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Links and Destinations

- [x] CHK031 Are the three links' relative order and visual priority specified (which is primary)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK032 Is "the series page" for Drift and Convergence identified unambiguously, including how a post's series is determined when it has several topics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK033 Are requirements stated for a series page, About page or Contact page that is hidden, draft or renamed, beyond the note that both are visible today? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Is the link-text pattern for a series ("More in Drift") defined for a future series name that is long? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK035 Is the no-series fallback destination consistent between the spec, the user stories and the success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §SC-003]

## Image and Performance

- [x] CHK036 Are the photo's display size, format and loading behaviour requirements stated in the spec, or only deferred to the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK037 Is "push the post page past the site's performance budget" tied to the numeric budget thresholds, and is the card's allowed share identified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK038 Are layout-shift requirements for the photo (reserved space before it loads) stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK039 Is reuse of the home page photo (including crop and alt text) consistent between the Assumptions and FR-002, given the home page alt text may be worded for a different context? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Scope and Maintainability

- [x] CHK040 Are posts-only boundaries (FR-013) defined for every non-post page type, including any page that reuses the post layout? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK041 Is "maintained in one place" defined so the single source covers photo, alt text, name and lines, and excludes link texts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK042 Are the out-of-scope items (structured data, other stale wording) traceable to follow-up records so they are not lost? [Traceability, Spec Out of Scope]
